result.reason: The operative language satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also satisfies the fallback. It is not minimal because it adds an unrequested one-year post-termination coverage period and an express own-expense obligation. The original bankruptcy and integration provisions remain substantively intact, but drafting quality is reduced by the duplicate Section 14.10 designation, placement after the execution recital, and the malformed prospective-renumbering sentence.
